case_studies.evidence_label: CCRI Institutional Effectiveness dashboard and F-1 international-student definition
case_studies.analyst_note: IPEDS jumps from 12 to 1,188 U.S. nonresident students between Fall 2023 and Fall 2024. CCRI's official Institutional Effectiveness enrollment dashboard independently reports total enrollment of 12,518 in Fall 2023 and 12,275 in Fall 2024, exactly matching the project IPEDS totals for both years. CCRI's official international-student admissions page separately defines an international student as a foreign national studying on an F-1 non-immigrant temporary visa and explicitly excludes U.S. citizens, permanent residents, eligible non-immigrant visa holders, refugees, asylees, and temporary protected status populations. That F-1-only admissions construct is narrower than the project IPEDS U.S. nonresident category, and the enrollment dashboard does not expose a directly comparable nonresident-status series. The exact all-student totals therefore corroborate the institutional frame while the explicit visa definition explains why CCRI's public international-student surface cannot validate the 12-to-1,188 nonresident jump. Preserve IPEDS in aggregates and keep institution-specific interpretation held pending a directly comparable residency/citizenship measure.

case_studies.evidence_label: Collin College FY2025 ACFR Fall Student Profile
case_studies.analyst_note: IPEDS rises from 433 U.S. nonresident students in Fall 2023 to 2,689 in Fall 2024 (+2,256). Collin's FY2025 ACFR reports Fall headcount of 37,776 in Fall 2023 and 39,552 in Fall 2024, within four of IPEDS totals, and the Foreign category rising from 612 to 2,482. Its 2023-24 CDS reports 604 International (nonresident) students. Institutional labels are not assumed IPEDS-identical and counts are not substituted. Preserve IPEDS as numerical authority and clear only bounded direction-level discussion of the +2,256 movement.

case_studies.evidence_label: New York State Education Department closure record
case_studies.analyst_note: The institution leaves the 2024 analytic universe after reporting 115 U.S. nonresident students in 2023. New York State Education Department records The College of Saint Rose as closed on December 31, 2024, with academic instruction ending earlier in 2024. The universe exit is therefore an expected structural event rather than an unexplained data disappearance.
